payload.state:
Review these proposed base-hour validation messages. Input must be a finite numeric value in inclusive range 0..8. Old text only described the upper bound; new text must explain the accepted numeric range. Judge grammar and clarity, not arithmetic.
RU: Введите базовые часы числом от 0 до 8.
KO: 기본 근로시간을 0~8 사이의 숫자로 입력하세요.
EN: Enter base hours as a number from 0 to 8.
KY: Негизги сааттарды 0дөн 8ге чейинки сан менен киргизиңиз.
UZ: Asosiy soatlarni 0 dan 8 gacha son bilan kiriting.
KK: Негізгі сағаттарды 0-ден 8-ге дейінгі санмен енгізіңіз.
Additional KO overtime rule: 근무표에 따른 근무일에 하루 8시간을 초과한 근로시간은 1.5×로 계산합니다. This must mean a scheduled working day, including ordinary Sunday shifts, rather than Mon-Fri only.
